correctness.rationale: For line graph L(Q3), explicitly build 12 edge-vertices, 24 adjacency edges and intrinsic vertex distances. Adams–Shukla–Singh Lemma 2.2 gives the full even/odd simplicial generators for each integer r and constancy on [r,r+1). Verified complete face sets at r2 (f-vector 12,60,104,60,12) and r3 (12,66,212,354,300,132,24). Independently rebuilt ordered greedy acyclic matchings r2:120 pairs/one 0-cell and seven 2-cells, all 732 Hasse incidences acyclic; r3:547 pairs/one 0-cell and five 3-cells, all 4644 incidences acyclic. Forman implies integral wedges of 7 S2 and 5 S3. r0 12 points, r1 cycle rank 24−12+1=13. Each vertex has a distinct unique antipode at distance three, hence r4 boundary of 11-simplex S10 and r5 full 11-simplex. Degrees disjoint at consecutive scales determine integral persistent barcode. Pure r2/r3 dimensions 4/6 with homology below top give non-shellability.
